findings.evidence: `rg` shows only these two public affine zero wrappers in this PR, while the analogous scale helper is private at `WindingNumberScale.lean:93`; lines 101-111 are just `rw [windingNumber_affine..., hzero]` and `rw [windingNumber_affine_preimage..., hzero]`.
findings.fix: Make these helpers `private` or remove them; consumers can rewrite with the public affine winding-number equalities, and null-homology already has its own public affine API.
findings.issue: `windingNumber_eq_zero_affine` and `windingNumber_eq_zero_affine_preimage` are public one-line wrappers around `windingNumber_affine` / `windingNumber_affine_preimage`, over-expanding the surface with duplicate pointwise-vanishing API.

summary: The affine winding-number API exposes duplicate zero wrappers that do not add characteristic content beyond the public affine rewrite lemmas.
